principle: Candidates are search space, not facts or canon. Reject ornamental synonyms; retain distinct meaning, provenance and evidence boundaries.
generation_rules: Derive candidates by ontology, scale, inverse, temporal transform, stakeholder, cultural translation and falsifier.
Do not treat algorithmic counterparts as proven antonyms; counterpart_hint is only a prompt.
Do not force wave uniqueness where controlled replication is valuable.
Keep CoG_dSide interpretations distinct from empirical observations.
Promote only after definition, relation, use case, example, counterexample and reviewer evidence.
